# WPT reftests the layout engine is measured against (stage 9's exit):
# `css/<module>/<test>.html`, each with the reference its `rel=match`
# names. tools/fetch-wpt.sh fetches them at the pin into
# tools/testdata/wpt/ (ignored by git); `zig build test` renders each
# beside its reference on an 800×600 canvas with the Ahem face and
# prints `wpt/<module>: N/M agree`. Scripted tests are not listed.
